question: Should HOOK.md automation receive a new completion event, and should that event represent an agent run ending or a persisted session lifecycle boundary?
rationale: Current main intentionally separates internal automation from typed plugin lifecycle hooks, and the requested payload mixes run-completion concepts with session-lifecycle terminology.

options.title: Use typed plugin hooks
options.body: Document `agent_end` for workflow task completion and `session_end` for persisted-session finalization, avoiding a duplicate internal event.

options.title: Add internal agent event
options.body: Expose a bounded internal `agent:end` event for lightweight task-completion automation while preserving `session:end` for true session lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Add internal session event
options.body: Expose internal `session:end` only at explicitly enumerated reset, deletion, shutdown, and replacement boundaries.

recommendation.title: Use typed plugin hooks
recommendation.body: Document `agent_end` for workflow task completion and `session_end` for persisted-session finalization, avoiding a duplicate internal event.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this contributor to both the internal-hook surface and recent agent/plugin lifecycle implementation.
